title: Ensure AAP 2.6 Inventory and Hosts
description: Ensures an organization and inventory exist in AAP 2.6, then adds only missing hosts to the inventory idempotently, reporting which hosts already existed, were added, or failed.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: org_name
parameters.description: Name of the organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: Name of the inventory to ensure exists inside the organization.

parameters.name: hosts
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames to add to the inventory. Leave empty to add no hosts.

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: IP address or hostname of the AAP controller API endpoint.

playbook_output.description: What the emit step's <result> block contains

fields.name: existing_hosts
fields.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that already existed in the inventory.

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that were successfully added.

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that failed to be added.

steps.name: Split host list
steps.function: Convert the comma-separated hosts input into a clean list of individual hostnames, handling empty input safely.

steps.name: Set organization facts
steps.function: Create facts for the organization name needed by subsequent modules and for reporting.

steps.name: Look up existing organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API to check if an organization with the given name exists.

steps.name: Does the organization already exist?
steps.function: Branch based on whether the lookup returned any results.
steps.condition: The organization lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create organization
steps.function: Ensure the organization exists using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Set inventory facts
steps.function: Create facts for the inventory name and organization needed by the inventory lookup.

steps.name: Look up existing inventory
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API to see if an inventory with the given name already exists in the organization.

steps.name: Does the inventory already exist?
steps.function: Branch based on whether the inventory lookup returned any results.
steps.condition: The inventory lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Extract inventory ID from lookup
steps.function: Pull the ID from the first result of the inventory lookup so later steps can reference the existing inventory.

computations._inv_id: The id of the first entry in _inv_lookup.

steps.name: Create inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.inventory module, storing the returned inventory ID for later host lookups.

steps.name: Look up existing hosts in inventory
steps.function: Retrieve all hosts currently in the inventory so we can determine which desired hosts are missing.

steps.name: Compute missing hosts
steps.function: Compare the desired host list with the hosts that already exist in the inventory to produce a list of only the ones that still need to be added.

computations._missing_hosts: Filter _desired_hosts to keep only those that are not already present in _existing_hosts.

steps.name: Stage host addition variables
steps.function: Gather the organization name, inventory name, and list of missing hosts into facts for the host addition loop.

steps.name: Add missing hosts
steps.function: Loop over only the missing host list and add each host to the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.host module. Errors per host are recorded for later summarization.

steps.name: Summarize host results
steps.function: Analyse the per-host results from the add-hosts loop and produce comma-separated lists of hosts that already existed (from the earlier lookup), were newly added, or failed.

computations._existing_hosts_csv: Join all entries in _existing_hosts with commas.
computations._added_hosts: For each entry in _host_results, keep the item field where changed is true and failed is false, then join with commas.
computations._failed_hosts: For each entry in _host_results, keep the item field where failed is true, then join with commas.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Setup
phases.description: Convert the host list and prepare organization and inventory facts.

phases.name: Organization Existence Check
phases.description: Look up the organization and create it only if it does not already exist.

phases.name: Inventory Existence Check and Creation
phases.description: Look up the inventory, then either extract its ID or create it, storing the inventory ID.

phases.name: Host Inventory Sync
phases.description: Retrieve existing hosts, compute missing ones, and add only those missing hosts to the inventory.

phases.name: Result Summarization & Reporting
phases.description: Summarise the host addition results and emit the final structured output.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
